newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: New mine seen boosting Philex PX income.
newsitem.headline: New mine seen boosting Philex PX income.

text.p: Philex Mining Corp said on Thursday the recent opening of its third gold mine would further boost its income this year.
"This will be a big year for us," chairman Gerard Brimo said in an interview after the company's annual shareholders meeting.
Income from operations of Philex this year is seen rising to 830 million pesos from last year's 109 million, a report to shareholders said.
It put projected profits for this year at 507 million pesos.

Philex declared a total net income of 1.4 billion pesos in 1996 but the bulk of it consisted of extraordinary income from the sale of its shares in Citytrust Banking Corp and from the initial public offering of its Canadian gold unit, Philex Gold Inc PGI.TO, officials said.
Philex's latest gold mine at Sibutad in Zamboanga del Norte in the southern Philippines began commercial operation at the start of the second quarter.
The Sibutad mine, run by Philex Gold Philippines Inc (PGPI), which is 81 percent owned by Philex Mining, is expected to produce 35,000 ounces of gold this year.
Production of PGPI's Bulawan mine in Negros Occidental, which started commercial operations last year, is forecast to rise to 165,000 ounces from 90,083, the report said.
Gold output of Philex Mining's own Padcal mine is forecast to rise to 141,273 ounces from last year's 91,402.
